trust_decision.summary: Untrusted multipart/form-data bodies are normalised into c.body by iterating form.keys() (one entry per field, duplicates included) and calling form.getAll(key) per entry, so cost is quadratic in the number of same-named fields; nested keys ('.'/'[') never set body[key], so the 'already seen' skip never applies to them. The fix groups entries once with form.forEach.

landing_point.why: The AOT (default) body parser for multipart lives in the adapter's parser.formData code-generator; searching for getAll/formData lands here first.

fix_sites.entry_point: Any route with a multipart/form-data body under default aot:true, via compose.ts parser emit (src/compose.ts:971-973); Bun and Cloudflare adapters inherit it (src/adapter/bun/index.ts:205, src/adapter/cloudflare-worker/index.ts:24)
aot:false dynamic handler, route with explicit multipart content type (src/index.ts:8098-8100)
aot:false dynamic handler, fallback on request content-type when no parse hook produced a body

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/dynamic-handle.ts:290-293, src/dynamic-handle.ts:350-353, src/dynamic-handle.ts:420-423 (aot:false handler, three copies)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: aot:false is a non-default, debug/compat mode; a solver fixing the generated parser can argue the dynamic handler is a legacy path not used in production.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Repeated field names must still become an array, a single '{'/'[' string must still be JSON-parsed, a JSON string plus File(s) under one key must merge into an object with file/files, and dotted/bracketed keys must still build nested objects; an over-broad fix (dedupe to first value, reject duplicates, cap field count) breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: many duplicate nested keys with '.' or '[n]' (body[key] skip never fires)
mixed string + File values under one key

O8b_injection_room.sibling: per-key nested-path setter that re-scans existing arrays/entries for each duplicate path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: setNestedValue already walks/initialises structures per key; a maintainer adding merge-on-duplicate could easily rescan per call.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: urlencoded/query duplicate-key aggregation done via a per-key lookup over all pairs
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same duplicate-key-to-array semantics as multipart; a URLSearchParams.getAll-based rewrite would be natural.

O9_family: algorithmic complexity (quadratic duplicate-key normalisation of multipart body)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Swap keys()+getAll for a grouped single pass only in the generated web-standard parser, or cap the number of multipart fields, leaving the aot:false dynamic handler copies quadratic.

out_of_scope_notes: src/parse-query.ts:100 uses push(...finalValue) on a client-controlled split array (spread argument size); different mechanism, not pursued.
unverified: No O8 routes found by grep for getAll/formData/keys() in src; Node universal request polyfill (src/universal/request.ts:164) not read in depth.
